blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device and holds only key Kuser
alt The user holds both Kdevice and Kuser
alt The user is away and the device exists
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < deviceB | ('key' : Kdevice , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('key' : Kdevice , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Kdevice) .

eq < UserX | ('keys' : Keys , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Kdevice) 
= < UserX | ('keys' : (Kdevice , Keys) , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('key' : Kdevice , ..) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' deviceB | (Kuser) 
= < deviceB | ('key' : Kdevice , ..) > $ deviceB 'bindCloud' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser) .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : nils , ..) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ....) > $ deviceB 'bindCloud' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : UserY , ..) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : nils , ..) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'bindCloud' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : UserY , ..) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , 'keys' : (Kuser) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Kuser) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , 'keys' : (Kuser) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , 'keys' : (Kuser) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Kuser) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , 'keys' : (Kuser) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('keys' : (Kdevice , Kuser , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, Kdevice, Kuser) @ S < UserX | ('keys' : (Kdevice , Kuser , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('keys' : (K , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, K, K) @ S < UserX | ('keys' : (K , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > .
